title: ARSAS 1.6.38 stable release
summary: ARSAS 1.6.38 is the physically verified R10 convergence release for trusted SCL reuse and live IEC 61850 reporting. Edition 2 and Edition 1 generated SCL were reopened and reconnected successfully with complete domain reconciliation, zero projection/cache loss, and report-backed runtime acquisition.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.38 adalah rilis convergence R10 yang telah diverifikasi fisik untuk trusted SCL reuse dan live IEC 61850 reporting. SCL Edition 2 dan Edition 1 hasil generate berhasil dibuka ulang dan reconnect dengan rekonsiliasi domain lengkap, tanpa projection/cache loss, serta runtime acquisition berbasis report.
highlights: R10 physical convergence: generated Edition 2 and Edition 1 SCL reopen and reconnect successfully across all 32/32 MMS domains.
Trusted-SCL initialization completed every planned read with failedReads=0, projectionErrors=0 and cacheLoss=0 on both editions.
Reporting converged to 58/58 report-backed runtime points with unresolvedRuntimePoints=0 and actual InformationReport traffic observed.
Multi-DO CF hydration uses exact DO-scoped structured Reads, removing cross-DO positional dependency during trusted-SCL reuse.
Exact-case IEC 61850 value identity is preserved through projection, cache and SCL instance-value export.
highlightsId: Convergence fisik R10: SCL Edition 2 dan Edition 1 hasil generate berhasil dibuka ulang dan reconnect pada seluruh 32/32 domain MMS.
Inisialisasi trusted-SCL menyelesaikan seluruh planned read dengan failedReads=0, projectionErrors=0, dan cacheLoss=0 pada kedua edition.
Reporting mencapai 58/58 runtime point berbasis report dengan unresolvedRuntimePoints=0 dan traffic InformationReport aktual teramati.
Hydration CF multi-DO memakai structured Read yang DO-scoped secara exact sehingga tidak bergantung pada urutan posisi antar-DO saat trusted-SCL reuse.
Identitas value IEC 61850 yang case-sensitive dipertahankan melalui projection, cache, dan export instance value SCL.
improvements: The application remains locked to the merged ARIEC61850 R10 engine authority whose source tree is identical to the physical-tested engine tree.
Post-merge CI now validates the accepted R10 physical authority and exact merged engine revision before stable publication.
Stable release identity, publish date, package size and SHA-256 remain sourced from verified release evidence.
Installer, portable binary, checksums, SPDX SBOM and provenance are produced by the official Windows release workflow.
improvementsId: Aplikasi tetap dikunci ke authority engine ARIEC61850 R10 yang sudah merged dan source tree-nya identik dengan engine tree yang diuji fisik.
CI post-merge sekarang memvalidasi authority fisik R10 yang diterima serta exact merged engine revision sebelum publikasi stable.
Identitas stable release, tanggal publikasi, ukuran paket, dan SHA-256 tetap diambil dari verified release evidence.
Installer, portable binary, checksum, SPDX SBOM, dan provenance diproduksi oleh official Windows release workflow.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation remains necessary for vendor-specific values, report behavior and field network conditions that cannot be reproduced by CI.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk value vendor-specific, perilaku report, dan kondisi network lapangan yang tidak dapat direproduksi oleh CI.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai, serta visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
